name: [ERR] Automation failure recorder
description: Error-trigger handler: records any managed workflow failure into integration_sync_runs.

nodes.name: Notify Slack
nodes.notes: Fed by Normalize Failure, not by Record Failed Run: the alert must not depend on the database write succeeding. Both limbs carry onError=continueRegularOutput so neither can swallow the other.

parameters.query:
with p as (select $1::jsonb as j)
insert into public.integration_sync_runs (
  provider, sync_type, n8n_execution_id, status, started_at, finished_at, error_message, metadata
)
select j->>'provider',
       'workflow_failure',
       j->>'n8n_execution_id',
       'failed',
       now(),
       now(),
       left(coalesce(nullif(j->>'error_detail', ''), j->>'error_message', 'Unknown workflow failure'), 4000),
       jsonb_build_object(
         'workflow_id',   j->>'workflow_id',
         'workflow_name', j->>'workflow_name',
         'last_node',     j->>'last_node',
         'error_summary', j->>'error_message',
         'error_codes',   nullif(j->>'error_codes', ''),
         'error_stack',   j->>'error_stack'
       )
from p
on conflict (n8n_execution_id) do update set
  status        = 'failed',
  finished_at   = now(),
  error_message = excluded.error_message,
  metadata      = public.integration_sync_runs.metadata || excluded.metadata
returning id::text as sync_run_id, provider, n8n_execution_id;
